title: Keyboard
description: Moonlander key usage by physical position: heatmap, never-pressed keys, habits and finger load.

panels.description: Presses per key by physical position over the time range, one panel per selected layer; colour by count, label is the key on that layer, number the presses.

panels.title: Presses per hour
panels.description: Key presses per hour, by layer.

targets.queryText: select hour*3600 as time, sum(case when layer = 'qwerty' then count else 0 end) as qwerty, sum(case when layer = 'workman' then count else 0 end) as workman, sum(case when layer = 'symbols' then count else 0 end) as symbols, sum(case when layer = 'numbers' then count else 0 end) as numbers, sum(case when layer = 'media' then count else 0 end) as media from key_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by hour order by hour
targets.rawQueryText: select hour*3600 as time, sum(case when layer = 'qwerty' then count else 0 end) as qwerty, sum(case when layer = 'workman' then count else 0 end) as workman, sum(case when layer = 'symbols' then count else 0 end) as symbols, sum(case when layer = 'numbers' then count else 0 end) as numbers, sum(case when layer = 'media' then count else 0 end) as media from key_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by hour order by hour

panels.title: Top 10 keys
panels.description: Most pressed keys (layer and the key on that layer) in the range.

targets.queryText: select u.layer || ' ' || case when kl.label = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else kl.label end as key, sum(u.count) as presses from key_usage u join key_layout k on k.row = u.row and k.col = u.col join key_label kl on kl.layer = u.layer and kl.row = u.row and kl.col = u.col where u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by u.layer, u.row, u.col order by presses desc limit 10
targets.rawQueryText: select u.layer || ' ' || case when kl.label = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else kl.label end as key, sum(u.count) as presses from key_usage u join key_layout k on k.row = u.row and k.col = u.col join key_label kl on kl.layer = u.layer and kl.row = u.row and kl.col = u.col where u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by u.layer, u.row, u.col order by presses desc limit 10

panels.title: Never pressed in the range
panels.description: Keys of the selected layers with no press in the time range (position as (row,col) when the layer has no label there).

targets.queryText: with layers(layer) as (values ('qwerty'), ('workman'), ('symbols'), ('numbers'), ('media')) select l.layer, case when kl.label = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else kl.label end as key, k.half as hand, k.row, k.col from layers l cross join key_layout k join key_label kl on kl.layer = l.layer and kl.row = k.row and kl.col = k.col where l.layer in (${layer:sqlstring}) and not exists (select 1 from key_usage u where u.layer = l.layer and u.row = k.row and u.col = k.col and u.count > 0 and u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000) order by l.layer, k.row, k.col
targets.rawQueryText: with layers(layer) as (values ('qwerty'), ('workman'), ('symbols'), ('numbers'), ('media')) select l.layer, case when kl.label = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else kl.label end as key, k.half as hand, k.row, k.col from layers l cross join key_layout k join key_label kl on kl.layer = l.layer and kl.row = k.row and kl.col = k.col where l.layer in (${layer:sqlstring}) and not exists (select 1 from key_usage u where u.layer = l.layer and u.row = k.row and u.col = k.col and u.count > 0 and u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000) order by l.layer, k.row, k.col

panels.title: Top modifier combos
panels.description: Presses made while a modifier was held, as modifier + key.

targets.queryText: select m.mods || ' + ' || case when case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end end as combo, sum(m.count) as presses from mod_usage m join key_layout k on k.row = m.row and k.col = m.col join key_label q on q.layer = 'qwerty' and q.row = m.row and q.col = m.col join key_label w on w.layer = 'workman' and w.row = m.row and w.col = m.col where m.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by m.mods, m.row, m.col order by presses desc limit 10
targets.rawQueryText: select m.mods || ' + ' || case when case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end end as combo, sum(m.count) as presses from mod_usage m join key_layout k on k.row = m.row and k.col = m.col join key_label q on q.layer = 'qwerty' and q.row = m.row and q.col = m.col join key_label w on w.layer = 'workman' and w.row = m.row and w.col = m.col where m.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by m.mods, m.row, m.col order by presses desc limit 10

panels.title: Tap, hold and misfire per dual-role key
panels.description: Mod-tap and layer-tap keys: taps, holds, and misfires (a hold released within 150 ms of resolving, or a tap repeated within 150 ms). The keymap has no such key yet.

targets.queryText: select case when case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end end as key, sum(case when d.kind = 'tap' then d.count else 0 end) as taps, sum(case when d.kind = 'hold' then d.count else 0 end) as holds, sum(case when d.kind = 'misfire' then d.count else 0 end) as misfires from dualrole_usage d join key_layout k on k.row = d.row and k.col = d.col join key_label q on q.layer = 'qwerty' and q.row = d.row and q.col = d.col join key_label w on w.layer = 'workman' and w.row = d.row and w.col = d.col where d.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by d.row, d.col order by taps + holds desc
targets.rawQueryText: select case when case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end = '' then '(' || k.row || ',' || k.col || ')' else case when q.label = w.label then q.label else q.label || '/' || w.label end end as key, sum(case when d.kind = 'tap' then d.count else 0 end) as taps, sum(case when d.kind = 'hold' then d.count else 0 end) as holds, sum(case when d.kind = 'misfire' then d.count else 0 end) as misfires from dualrole_usage d join key_layout k on k.row = d.row and k.col = d.col join key_label q on q.layer = 'qwerty' and q.row = d.row and q.col = d.col join key_label w on w.layer = 'workman' and w.row = d.row and w.col = d.col where d.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by d.row, d.col order by taps + holds desc

panels.title: Time on top per layer
panels.description: Seconds each layer was the highest active layer.

targets.queryText: select layer, sum(held_ms) / 1000.0 as seconds from layer_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by layer order by seconds desc
targets.rawQueryText: select layer, sum(held_ms) / 1000.0 as seconds from layer_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by layer order by seconds desc

panels.title: Layer entries
panels.description: How often each layer was entered.

targets.queryText: select layer, sum(entries) as entries from layer_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by layer order by entries desc
targets.rawQueryText: select layer, sum(entries) as entries from layer_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by layer order by entries desc

panels.title: Load per finger
panels.description: Share of all presses by finger (standard home position, thumbs on the thumb cluster and the lowest inner key).

targets.queryText: select k.half || ' ' || k.finger as finger, sum(u.count) * 100.0 / (select sum(count) from key_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000) as share from key_usage u join key_layout k on k.row = u.row and k.col = u.col where u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by k.half, k.finger order by k.half, case k.finger when 'pinky' then 1 when 'ring' then 2 when 'middle' then 3 when 'index' then 4 else 5 end
targets.rawQueryText: select k.half || ' ' || k.finger as finger, sum(u.count) * 100.0 / (select sum(count) from key_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000) as share from key_usage u join key_layout k on k.row = u.row and k.col = u.col where u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by k.half, k.finger order by k.half, case k.finger when 'pinky' then 1 when 'ring' then 2 when 'middle' then 3 when 'index' then 4 else 5 end

panels.title: Load per hand
panels.description: Share of all presses by hand.

targets.queryText: select k.half as hand, sum(u.count) * 100.0 / (select sum(count) from key_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000) as share from key_usage u join key_layout k on k.row = u.row and k.col = u.col where u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by k.half order by k.half
targets.rawQueryText: select k.half as hand, sum(u.count) * 100.0 / (select sum(count) from key_usage where hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000) as share from key_usage u join key_layout k on k.row = u.row and k.col = u.col where u.hour*3600 between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by k.half order by k.half
